column4: A map is **valid** when it is a locally   finite map of the plane bounded by segments and circular arcs, **arcs of radius 1 allowed** (Condition 5 dropped), carrying a six-colouring in which no   two interior points of one colour are at distance exactly 1. A **unit arc** is a boundary arc of radius 1; **(Q)** an arc whose centre carries both   side colours and at least four colours; **(R2)** an arc whose centre carries the outer side colour and not the inner, with an inner-colour tile along   the radius-2 circle over the whole arc. `M*` is a terminal valid modification (N2-TERM). `F(M)`: the vertices of at least four colours; `R(M)`: the   vertices carrying a repeated colour.
periodic designs with at most `K` circular or straight arcs   per tile, arc radii at least `1/K`, at most `K` tiles per unit disc
